external_sources.title: Templates for the Solution of Algebraic Eigenvalue Problems, Singular Matrix Pencils: Kronecker Canonical Form
external_sources.hypotheses: Arbitrary rectangular complex matrix pencil A-lambda*B, with projective homogenization to include infinity.
external_sources.imported_statement: Strict equivalence decomposes a complex pencil into finite/infinite regular blocks and right/left singular Kronecker blocks Lj and LjT.
